limitations: Visual scores require human inspection of the full-resolution PNGs; this harness does not assign photorealism scores.
The candidate may change material shaders; the report records both shader hashes and verifies unchanged environment, display transform, camera and light uniforms.
This is a local native Chromium capture, not a cross-device performance benchmark.
